questions.stem_text: Which of the following is not recognised as a level of society?

options.A: we internalise and take on social roles from a pre-existing framework
options.B: we create and negotiate our roles through interaction with others
options.C: social roles are not fixed or stable but fluid and pluralistic
options.D: roles have to be learned to suppress unconscious motivations

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - we internalise and take on social roles from a pre-existing framework
